findings.finding: cyber_Folks beat mBank's adjusted EBITDA forecast in each of the last three reported quarters: Q3'25 75.7m vs 72.0m, Q1'26 83.1m vs 77.6m, Q2'26 88.3m vs 82.4m, about +5-7% each time. On two of those three the stock fell the next session (-5.46% on 6 Nov 2025, -2.46% on 3 Sep 2026).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Beats are sold here: Q3'25 beat (EBITDA 69.9 vs PAP 67.9) then -5.46%; Q2'26 revenue and EBIT beat then -2.46%; Q1'26 beat then +1.01% (the +10.7% on 21 May was the Shoper merger plan, not the print). Prices from Yahoo CBF.WA.
findings.source_date: 2025-11-05 17:57; mBank Q1/Q2 2026 forecasts from snippets of https://www.gpw.pl/pub/pwpa/20260421_mbank_cbf_pl_pw.pdf and https://www.gpw.pl/pub/pwpa/20260723_mbank_cbf_pl_pw.pdf (snippet_only, gpw.pl refuses)
findings.original_quote: cyber_Folks miał w trzecim kwartale 2025 roku 69,9 mln zł EBITDA, a konsensus PAP Biznes zakładał EBITDA w wysokości 67,9 mln zł ... skorygowana EBITDA wyniosła 76 mln zł (cyber_Folks had 69.9m PLN EBITDA in Q3 2025 against a PAP Biznes consensus of 67.9m ... adjusted EBITDA was 76m)
findings.why_not_priced: The beat pattern is visible to all five covering analysts, who should have raised forecasts after it. If the market priced a beat, the stock would have drifted up into the print; instead it slid from 213 (22 Sep) to 194 with a flat 20-day run-up. The pattern says the print is probably slightly above the bar, but the reaction to beats has been negative.

findings.finding: Vercom, fully consolidated by CBF, raised MailerLite prices and cut the free-plan subscriber limit in July 2026. Management expects about 20m PLN of extra annual revenue, 'largely' falling to gross margin and EBITDA, so roughly 4-5m PLN a quarter from Q3, or about 5% of a ~93m CBF quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior MailerLite price change in about three years, so there is no reaction history on this line.
findings.original_quote: Zarząd szacuje, że w skali roku dadzą one około 20 mln zł dodatkowych przychodów, przekładających się w dużej mierze wprost na marżę brutto i EBITDA. (Management estimates the changes will add about 20m PLN of revenue a year, largely flowing straight to gross margin and EBITDA.)
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly priced. It was disclosed in September, and it sits inside Vercom's reiterated 165m 2026 target, so analysts likely model it. Q3 is the first quarter it can show, and churn from the price rise is unknown. VRC fell from 131 (30 Sep) to 115-120 in November, which does not look like a market pricing an upside surprise.

findings.finding: Insiders bought after the Q2 print. The CEO's family foundation (Fundacja Rodzinna Jakuba i Magdaleny Dwernickich) bought on 8 and 14 Sep, and VP Robert Stasik on 8 Sep, at about 190-201 PLN, close to the current 194.3.
findings.original_quote: Nabycie akcji przez Fundację Rodzinna Jakuba i Magdaleny Dwernickich; Nabycie akcji przez wiceprezesa zarządu (Purchase of shares by the Jakub and Magdalena Dwernicki Family Foundation; purchase of shares by the vice-president of the management board), as listed on https://www.stockwatch.pl/gpw/cyberflks,notowania,komunikaty.aspx
findings.why_not_priced: Public for two months, and the stock drifted lower afterwards, so the market did not treat it as information. Insiders buying at this level two months before Q3 closed its books is a weak lean.

findings.finding: Sinch, Vercom's largest listed CPaaS peer, reported Q3 2026 on 5 Nov: EMEA email gross profit grew double digits, while 'traditional SMS and Applications businesses predominately in EMEA and APAC experience weaker demand' and EMEA organic gross profit fell 2%. This matches Vercom's mix of email (MailerLite) and SMS; the two effects offset.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: VRC fell 1.9% on 5 Nov, the day of Sinch's print. The proxy has no measured history on CBF.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a proxy, and it is public. Vercom's SMS business is Polish domestic A2P, not Sinch's operator contracts, and the transmission is unproven. Filed for completeness at zero.

findings.finding: Q3 sits inside the company's own ESOP EBITDA path: the 2026 target is 365m PLN, about 47% was done in H1 (171.4m), and H2 needs about 194m, roughly +22% on H2 2025, in line with Q2's +23%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: First year this ESOP target exists; no history.
findings.original_quote: cyber_Folks i Vercom na drodze do realizacji celu ESOP. Blisko 50% rocznego celu zrealizowane w H1 2026 r. (cyber_Folks and Vercom on track to meet the ESOP target. Close to 50% of the annual target achieved in H1 2026.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: a print on this path is what the company told the market to expect. It is filed because it is the only company-sourced bar.

findings.finding: Q3 is the first quarter after the Shoper merger took effect on 1 Sep 2026; 3.2m new series F shares were issued to Shoper minorities. Minority interest in Shoper falls away for September, mechanically lifting net profit attributable, while merger one-offs land in the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 reported a net loss on a tax one-off while adjusted figures beat, and the stock fell 2.46%. The market reads adjusted numbers, but a reported miss can still weigh.
findings.original_quote: cyber_Folks finalizuje połączenie z Shoperem. Powstaje jeden podmiot o kapitalizacji blisko 1 mld USD. (cyber_Folks completes its merger with Shoper, creating one entity worth close to USD 1bn.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mechanical and known; analysts model it. Near zero.

Buyback of at least 500k shares over 5-6 years plus a rising DPS commitment; no dated start

lessons_applied: 'You were right about the number and too small about the move' and 'numbers new, not pre-released': abs_move_pct 4.0 -> 4.5. Held below the 7.4% pooled base because no guidance change is expected (2.3% median when the guide is reiterated or none is given) and the name's realised volatility is 16%.
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' (this name sold two of its last three beats): beat-pattern finding 0.2 -> 0.1; p_up kept at 51.
'Lands inside what was guided' (MailerLite effect inside Vercom's reiterated 165m target, disclosed 10 Sep): 0.3 -> 0.2.
Insider buying is two months old and the stock fell afterwards, so the finding is treated as priced positioning: 0.2 -> 0.1.
